name: nova-agent
description: A fast, local AI coding agent for VS Code — paste your Anthropic API key and let Claude run bash and edit files. Connects only while active and disconnects when idle.

commands.title: Nova Agent: Set Anthropic API Key
Nova Agent: Clear API Key & Disconnect

novaAgent.models.description: Models shown in the sidebar picker. Add any model your key/endpoint supports.

novaAgent.baseUrl.description: Optional Anthropic-compatible API base URL (leave blank for api.anthropic.com). Point this at any gateway/proxy that speaks the Anthropic Messages API to use other models.

novaAgent.idleDisconnectMinutes.description: Disconnect from Claude after this many minutes of inactivity (0 = never).

novaAgent.requireBashApproval.description: Ask for approval before the agent runs any shell (bash) command.

novaAgent.autoApprovePatterns.description: Commands matching any of these (regex, or a literal prefix if not valid regex) run without a prompt. Example: ["^git status", "^ls", "^npm test"].

novaAgent.bashTimeoutMs.description: Per-command timeout for the bash tool, in milliseconds.
